svg.title: H100 torch advantage by matrix shape
svg.desc: Rows give N and K; columns give M for A[M,K] @ B[K,N]. Each cell is the geometric mean reference/torch ratio for that shape. Duplicate shapes across model families are averaged, not extra devices. Orange favors torch, blue favors Triton. Cell ratios are rounded to two decimals; tooltips give six decimals. A displayed 1.00 need not be a tie.

g.text: H100 torch advantage by matrix shape
Bank-2 reference / torch medians · reference selected on bank 1
Repeated shapes across models: geometric mean; not independent devices
Color saturates at ⅛× and 8×. Rounded 1.00× need not be a tie; tooltips give six decimals.
